column1: # One row per run of the 1,000-search review. grade_sum is the sum of all
# 1,000 grades (0 to 3 each); popular..everyday are each lane's mean grade.
# great..useless count searches by grade (3, 2, 1, 0). known_* count the
# known-answer searches with the answer at #1 and in the top 3. Times are
# seconds per search on the test server. charts.py draws docs/search-quality/*.svg from this file.
